html:
Given unsorted integers, return the length of the longest run of consecutive distinct integer values. Duplicate values do not extend a run.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      8,
      3,
      5,
      4,
      4,
      10
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 3
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": 0
}
Hint

Only begin a walk at a value with no predecessor.

Complexity: O(n) expected time and space
